title: Controller Adapter 510 Cart Battery
body:
Smyle™ Controller Adapter 510 Cart Battery

Turn your controller into a convenient home base for your aromatherapy cartridge. The Smyle™ Controller Adapter combines a compact 510 battery with a magnetic mounting system designed to attach directly to your gaming controller.

With four voltage settings, preheat mode, USB-C charging, and a 300 mAh battery, it keeps your cartridge right where you want it without getting in the way of your grip.

Designed for Your Setup

Simply attach one of the included magnetic plates to your controller, twist in your compatible cartridge, and snap the battery into place. The lightweight design keeps everything close at hand while staying out of the way during gameplay.

Choose between four voltage levels depending on your preferred setting, activate preheat mode when needed, and recharge easily with USB-C.

The magnetic mounting system works with most gaming controllers and includes two mounting plates so you can set up more than one controller.

Key Features

  • 510 thread compatible
  • Magnetic controller mounting system
  • Works with most gaming controllers
  • Four adjustable voltage settings
  • 2.5V, 2.7V, 3.0V, and 3.6V
  • Preheat mode
  • 300 mAh rechargeable battery
  • USB-C charging
  • Compact and lightweight design
  • Two magnetic mounting plates included
  • Height adapter included

How It Works

  1. Attach the Magnetic Plate
    Place one of the included magnetic mounting plates on your controller.
  2. Install Your Cartridge
    Twist your compatible 510 cartridge onto the battery.
  3. Snap It Into Place
    Magnetically attach the Controller Adapter to your controller and you're ready to go.

Voltage Settings

Low 2.5V (Green) · Medium 2.7V (Blue) · High 3.0V (Purple) · Max 3.6V (Red)

What's Included

  • 1 × Smyle™ Controller Adapter 510 Battery
  • 2 × Magnetic Mounting Plates
  • 1 × Height Adapter
  • 1 × Start Guide
